newsitem.title: USA: Enron proposes to merge Enron Global.
newsitem.headline: Enron proposes to merge Enron Global.

text.p: Enron Corp is proposing to merge Enron Global Power & Pipelines LLC Enron Global into it, paying Enron common stock worth $32 a share for each share of Enron Global, the companies said Wednesday.
Enron Global has about 26 million shares outstanding. of which Enron Corp owns 13.5 million shares, with the remaining 12.5 million shares in the public market.
Enron Global shares closed Wednesday up 2-1/8 at 32-3/8.
Enron Corp shares closed down 1/4 at 41.

Enron Corp said the proposal has been submitted to an oversight committee of the board at Enron Global. Enron Global said the committee will appoint financial and legal advisors to review the proposal.
"It is expected that it will be several weeks before the oversight committee completes its evaluation," the companies said in a joint statement.
